tex_content.html:
Theorem
Source: topping:page-0096 ↗ topping-ch8-minimiser-exists ↗ topping-ch8-monotonicity 1. ch8:3.4\group perelman-w-entropy

Suppose $g(t)$ is a Ricci flow on a closed $\mathcal M$ for $t\in [0,T]$. Compute $\mathcal V$, $R$, and balls using $g(T)$. For $p\in \mathcal M$ and $r>0$, \[ \gamma \leq \frac{\mathcal V(p,r)}{\mathcal V(p,r/2)} +\frac{r^2}{\mathcal V(p,r/2)}\int _{B(p,r)}|R|\, dV +\ln \mathcal K(p,r), \] where $\gamma \in \mathbb R$ depends on $n$, $g(0)$, and upper bounds for $r$ and $T$.

Proof

\sketch Apply Lemma 1.2 with $g=g(T)$ and $\lambda =1/36$. This gives

\[ \mu \left(g(T),\frac{r^2}{36}\right) \leq \frac{\mathcal V(p,r)}{\mathcal V(p,r/2)} +\frac{r^2}{\mathcal V(p,r/2)}\int _{B(p,r)}|R|\, dV +\ln \mathcal K(p,r)-\frac n2\ln \frac\pi 9-n. \]

Choose a minimizing compatible $f_T$ at $\tau =r^2/36$ and solve the coupled system backward with $\tau =T+r^2/36-t$ and final value $f_T$. Compatibility is preserved, and monotonicity gives

\[ \mu \left(g(0),T+\frac{r^2}{36}\right) \leq \mathcal W\left(g(0),f(0),T+\frac{r^2}{36}\right) \leq \mu \left(g(T),\frac{r^2}{36}\right). \]

The lower bound defining $\nu (g(0),T+r_0^2/36)$ absorbs the constants and yields the stated $\gamma $.

□
